summary: Possum Trot fire tower in Shannon County, Missouri; torn down in April 1938 and re-erected on Tram Ridge per 1938 newspaper reports; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Fire-detection tower; a March 1938 report describes a new fifty-foot steel tower footed on the site
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts lists the tower as removed. A 1938 report says it was torn down and re-erected on Tram Ridge. A 1942 item still mentions work on a Possum Trot tower, so it is unclear whether a tower stood on the site afterward. No source describes the site today.

corrections.why: Wikipedia says the Clark National Forest was combined with Mark Twain in 1973 and absorbed by it in 1976; Wikidata places the site inside Mark Twain National Forest. Clark is the name used on the Forest Lookouts page for the older records.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts and its 1937-38 headers use the Clark National Forest name, and the NARA catalog and Wikidata use Mark Twain National Forest. Clark was merged into Mark Twain, so the current agency is Mark Twain.

notes_for_editor: The 1937-38 sequence is ambiguous. The Possum Trot tower was reported torn down in April 1938 and re-erected at Tram, yet a footing for a new fifty-foot steel tower was poured on the Possum Trot site in March 1938, and a 1942 item still mentions a Possum Trot tower. The story says the sources do not settle it. No build date or builder was found, so no built event is dated. Record elevation 306 m matches Wikidata 1,004 ft. Record agency corrected from Clark to Mark Twain. The NARA photo is already in the record, so no new photos. No access or visit information was found. A Tram story, if one exists, should cross-reference this relocation.
